134:56.en: 「We can do this too!\nWe'll show them!」

134:105.en: 「We eat after this! Keep it up!」
alternatives: We eat when this is over! Hang on!
This is the soul of Team Dai-Gurren!

134:440.en: 「My wife's the best in the universe!」

134:532.en: 「Same old thing, so I won't ask...」

134:855.en: 「Been a while! Let's blow them away!」

134:894.en: 「I died once,\nbut my soul isn't dead!」

134:945.en: 「There's probably no next time!\nI'll go wild while I can!」

134:1088.en: 「Some amazing robots showed up\nwhile I was gone!」

134:1233.en: 「I've died once already!\nUse me as your shield!」

134:1284.en: 「My job is to blaze a trail onward!」

134:1325.en: 「No holding back! Let's go all out!」

134:1417.en: 「Dig and dig till I break through!」

134:1450.en: 「Each turn of the drill moves us on!」

134:1673.en: 「Who says this ends in one shot?!」

134:1943.en: 「Like I'd let a monster run loose!」

alternatives: This is the soul of Team Dai-Gurren!

134:2642.en: 「I'll leave this to you, $$ダヤッカ$$!」

134:2978.en: 「$$ヨーコ$$'s someone I can really rely on!」

134:3013.en: 「$$ダヤッカ$$ will make a good father!」

134:3414.en: 「$$ダリー$$, fall back and support us!」

134:3447.en: 「I'll show $$竜馬$$ what I'm made of!」

134:3594.en: 「I'll be sure to repay you later!」

134:3752.en: 「What the hell are you aiming at?!」

134:3779.en: 「You didn't even graze me! Try again!」

134:3820.en: 「So weak,\na fly could land on it!」

134:3869.en: 「You couldn't hit me in a lifetime!」

134:3908.en: 「I'll knock it back with the barrier!」

134:4408.en: 「I don't give up!\nThat's how I live!」

134:4604.en: 「Heh... I can't afford to slip up!」

134:4645.en: 「Good, $$ヴィラル$$! That's more like it!」

134:5399.en: 「$$グレンラガン$$ never goes halfway!」

134:5582.en: 「$$ヴィラル$$! You can eject first!」

134:5625.en: 「Heh...! Who do you think I am?!」

134:5840.en: 「Sorry, $$ヴィラル$$... This is my limit...」

134:6658.en: 「I'll say it as often as it takes...!」

134:6824.en: 「Game over! Do that move, $$ヴィラル$$!」

134:6875.en: 「What do you think this game is?!」

134:6914.en: 「Who do you think we are, huh?!」

134:6953.en: 「Who the hell do you think we are?!」

134:7015.en: 「So this is $$グレンラガン$$'s power!」

134:7154.en: 「Hey! How will you split the power?!」

134:7548.en: 「You won't let them escape, will you?」

134:7610.en: 「We'll have to bide our time for now!」

134:7676.en: 「Looks like I didn't need to pilot!」

134:7894.en: 「You can't beat this thing like that!」

134:7981.en: 「I've felt how tough this thing is!」

134:8024.en: 「Hmph! This is so easy, I'm bored!」

134:8120.en: 「So there was no need to dodge.」

134:8628.en: 「A bad joke!\nI won't turn my back!」

134:8791.en: 「This is bad! The machine won't last!」

134:9147.en: 「A weapon this big begs to be used!」

134:9538.en: 「Yes... No matter how hard it is...!」

alternatives: Too forceful! You don't get women!
This is where I show my skill!!

134:10180.en: 「All right! Who wants a hole first?!」

134:10274.en: 「Cover me, $$ヴィラル$$! I'm counting on it!」

134:10479.en: 「I'll slam that soul's fire into you!」

134:10639.en: 「We'll sweep them all away at once!」

134:10662.en: 「I can count on you, $$ロージェノム$$!」

134:10695.en: 「First, let's hit them with a blast!」

134:10749.en: 「Anyone in our way gets blown aside!」

134:10780.en: 「I'll take them all out at once!」

134:10836.en: 「Even against you, I go all out...!」

134:10873.en: 「I'll stop it and set you free!」

134:11006.en: 「I'll blast you back to your planet!」

134:11155.en: 「Whoever you are, I'm taking a swing!」

134:11196.en: 「Whoever you are,\nI do what I do!」

134:11247.en: 「If words fail, my fists will speak!」

134:11288.en: 「If talk fails, I've got to do this!」

134:11619.en: 「Last one! I'll spin my drill dry!」

134:11660.en: 「I just have to push back against\nanyone who lords it over me!」

134:11768.en: 「I'll punch a hole in your $$スフィア$$!」

134:11811.en: 「Your $$スフィア$$ versus my drill!\nLet's see which is stronger!」

134:11870.en: 「Don't steal others' happiness\nwith your selfish logic!」

134:11925.en: 「Even if you're immortal,\nmy drill won't lose!」

134:11976.en: 「To hell with the fate\nyou forced on me!」

134:12033.en: 「To bore through to our future,\nI dig and dig and dig on!」

134:12475.en: 「You dig a mean hole as ever, $$アンディ$$!」

134:12696.en: 「$$グレンラガン$$ will handle it!」

134:12881.en: 「That attack will put me to sleep!」

134:13121.en: 「I've got plenty to say, but later!」

134:13191.en: 「This is fun! A worthy foe at last!」

134:13363.en: 「Hope and despair twist at the end!」

134:13489.en: 「$$アーテンボロー$$? You're fired up...」

134:13770.en: 「I'm moving on! You can't stop me!」

134:13809.en: 「You'll regret making an enemy\nof $$シモン$$ the Digger!」

134:13864.en: 「The drill is my way of life!\nI'll show it to you too!」

134:13921.en: 「Burn the $$大グレン団$$ leader's\nway of life into your eyes!」

134:14065.en: 「$$ヴィラル$$! Let's charge with everything!」

134:14100.en: 「The tougher the barrier,\nthe more fun it is to smash!」

134:14194.en: 「Before you wipe out humanity,\nwe'll wipe you out!」

134:14255.en: 「My drill pierces every enemy\nstanding in humanity's way!」

134:14365.en: 「That huge body...!\nI'll give it some ventilation!」

134:14416.en: 「The bigger the opponent,\nthe more fired up I get!」

134:14563.en: 「If you still want a war,\nI'll take you on!」

134:14616.en: 「My drill will bore through\nthis thing called war!」

134:14710.en: 「Man or machine, a crook's a crook!」

134:14749.en: 「Lose to a parting gift from\n$$アンチスパイラル$$? No way!」

134:14804.en: 「The universe's peace entrusted to me\nI'll protect it!」

134:14855.en: 「Don't underestimate Earth's humans,\n$$サイデリアル$$!」

134:14904.en: 「$$サイデリアル$$!\nYou face $$シモン$$ the Digger!」

134:15045.en: 「I'll pierce you, $$スフィア$$ and all!」

134:15084.en: 「Your poison? My guts will repel it!」

134:15127.en: 「Hey, you!\nCan you get pumped in silence?!」

134:15182.en: 「As for your tactics,\nI'll kick them aside!」

134:15272.en: 「A man's fight isn't about titles!\nLet's go, Emperor!」

134:15325.en: 「$$次元将$$, $$スフィア$$ power!\nI'll pierce it all at once!」

134:15380.en: 「The root of it all, the $$御使い$$...!\nI'll never forgive you!」

134:15429.en: 「So what, an emissary of God?!\nDon't think you can stop me!」

134:15480.en: 「Humanity and I aren't cheap enough\nto be destroyed by selfish logic!」

134:15543.en: 「It's my drill that will judge you!」

134:15578.en: 「Touch me for fun and you'll\nget more than burned!」

134:15631.en: 「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$!\nHow dare you deceive us!」

134:15686.en: 「I'll land one on that smug face!」

134:15780.en: 「Don't think you can look down\non humanity forever!」

134:15880.en: 「Nothing in this world is immortal!\nI'll teach you that!」

134:15984.en: 「It's not you who saves the world!\nIt's everyone who lives in it!」

134:16051.en: 「Let's go, buddy!\nThis is the true final battle!」

134:16439.en: 「Heh... You and me are even, right?」

134:16703.en: 「$$ノノ$$'s effort and grit + my spirit!」

134:17077.en: 「No time to get nostalgic,\n$$ヴィラル$$.」

134:17257.en: 「Don't underestimate me...!\nMy fighting spirit has no ceiling!」

134:17306.en: 「I'll make you regret failing\nto finish me off...!」

134:17361.en: 「In that case,\nI'll end it with the next blow!」

134:17455.en: 「Hope, despair, future, past! Twisted paths cross in the final battle!」
